text:
Stradal Group has acquired Fennimore Optics in an all-cash deal valued at 412 million credits, the company confirmed after the sale was announced on 14 March 2031.

Helena Vörsch, Chief Executive of Stradal Group, confirmed the purchase. "Fennimore Optics is now part of Stradal Group, and the transaction was completed as a full cash purchase," she said.

The details are set out in the joint merger filing lodged with the Calderon Basin Trade Registry, which records the price and the terms of the sale. The filing was submitted by both companies.

The announcement ends Fennimore Optics' run as an independent business. The filing does not say how the acquisition will affect the company's operations.
